sentences.en: A gas stove provides the most even heat for cooking.
sentences.zh: 燃气炉烹饪时能提供最均匀的热量。

sentences.en: We have a big stove which keeps us very toasty.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个大炉子，让我们感觉非常暖和。

sentences.en: Heat was spread throughout the room by the electric stove.
sentences.zh: 电炉在整个房间内散发热量。

phrases.zh: 热锅（比喻危险或麻烦的事物）
